review_scope: Pure Python AST/compile and source field/order/pin review; no imports or execution of tool main/helper/CIM, no live backend sampling

findings.detail: Only broad qa-world directory, overallfalse, lock_releasedtrue and truthy finished_utc are checked. No exact run/schema/producer/source6/raw receipt SHA binds the decision to the latest night backend. An oldfalse receipt can therefore permit reversal even if a later actual full run qualified. Even a three-key unrelated JSON is sufficient for the receipt predicate.
CIM filter relies only on CommandLine markers; missing metadata makes known own PID disappear from blocked rows. Explicit known producer/consumer PID checks are required.

Fresh output is opened only after both source writes, without mutation finally. Second-file/write/output failure leaves actual partial source state without new failure receipt and an ordinary rerun no longer matches afterSHA.

disposition: Preserve original7045 as historical unexecuted rejected candidate; do not execute it. New sibling required.
